assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original transparent character illustration for a premium timed mathematics adventure app for students in grades 5–9.
Scene/backdrop: fully isolated on a genuinely transparent background with preserved alpha channel; no environment, no floor, no background color.
Subject: a youthful, confident adventurer and portal guardian guide warmly welcoming the student before a challenge. Expressive natural face, relaxed supportive smile, age-appropriate sophisticated adventure design. One open inviting hand, the other hand resting naturally on a sheathed sword. Teal and navy layered jacket with short cape, small brushed-gold details. No weapon drawn.
Style/medium: high-quality contemporary adventure game editorial character key art; stylized semi-realistic painted/3D hybrid, appealing natural proportions, clean broad shapes and subtle material texture. Mature premium art direction, not childish, not chibi, not cartoon.
Composition/framing: square image approximately 1024 × 1024 pixels. Three-quarter body portrait, relaxed three-quarter pose, composed to sit on the right side of a split-screen layout, slightly turned toward the left. Entire head and both hands clearly inside image with generous margins; figure occupies most of the height while keeping comfortable transparent space around silhouette.
Lighting/mood: soft flattering light, tasteful cool aqua/cyan rim light on the figure and warm highlights; inviting confidence.
Color palette: unified deep navy, rich teal, aqua and restrained brushed gold. Soft dimensional shading, polished readable silhouette.
Constraints: exactly one original character, genuine transparent cutout, clean alpha edges. No text, symbols, lettering, logos, watermark, UI, environment, floating tiny ornaments, checkerboard rendered into pixels, background glow cloud, or cut-off head or hands.
